channel.title: Government Emergency Monitoring
channel.description: Normalized Government of Canada emergency-related feeds

item.title: Joint Statement by Ministers Anandasangaree and Fraser on the final report from the Progress Monitoring Committee
item.description: Today, the Honourable Gary Anandasangaree, Minister of Public Safety, and the Honourable Sean Fraser, Minister of Justice and Attorney General of Canada and Minister responsible for the Atlantic Canada Opportunities Agency, issued the following statement:

item.title: Government of Canada to match donations to the Red Cross’ 2026 British Columbia Wildfires Appeal
item.description: Today, the Honourable Eleanor Olszewski, Minister of Emergency Management and Community Resilience and Minister responsible for Prairies Economic Development Canada, announced that the Government of Canada will match donations to the Canadian Red Cross’ 2026 British Columbia Wildfires Appeal in support of wildfires disaster relief and recovery efforts in British Columbia (B.C.).

item.title: Government of Canada announces funding for Indigenous-led alternatives to incarceration in Manitoba
item.description: Today, the Honourable Rebecca Chartrand, Minister of Northern and Arctic Affairs and Minister responsible for the Canadian Northern Economic Development Agency, on behalf of the Honourable Gary Anandasangaree, Minister of Public Safety, announced $5 million in federal funding to the Manitoba Keewatinowi Okimakanak (MKO) to support Indigenous-led alternatives to incarceration for First Nations individuals.

item.title: The Government of Canada provides an update regarding the 2026 wildfire season – August update
item.description: As of today, there are 582 active wildfires nationally including 31 that are out of control, with full response. In total this season, there have been 4,793 fires and 4.1 million hectares burned. Last year we saw fewer fires at this time – 4,584 fires by mid-August - but a more significant number of hectares burned – 7.7 million.

item.title: Responding to Canada’s 2026 wildfire season
item.description: Wildfires continue to impact communities across Canada. The Government of Canada’s Wildfires 2026 web page includes vital information about programs, policies and initiatives to keep Canadians informed about the ongoing wildfire situation across the country.

item.title: Government of Canada supports search and rescue in Québec by investing in boating safety initiative
item.description: Today, on behalf of the Honourable Eleanor Olszewski, Minister of Emergency Management and Community Resilience and Minister responsible for Prairies Economic Development Canada, the Honourable François-Philippe Champagne, Minister of Finance and National Revenue and Member of Parliament for Saint-Maurice–Champlain, Québec, announced $378,700 in funding to the Regional County Municipality of Les Chenaux (MRC des Chenaux) for their one-year initiative entitled Safe Navigation: Awareness, Prevention and Implementation of Boating Safety in the MRC des Chenaux.

item.title: Ministers Olszewski and Gull-Masty to provide an update on Canada’s 2026 wildfire season
item.description: Members of the media are invited to join the Honourable Eleanor Olszewski, Minister of Emergency Management and Community Resilience and Minister responsible for Prairies Economic Development Canada, and the Honourable Mandy Gull-Masty, Minister of Indigenous Services, as they provide an update on the forecast for the 2026 wildfires season.

item.title: Government of Canada invests in volunteer search and rescue across Canada with a three-year funding agreement
item.description: Across Canada, thousands of search and rescue volunteers answer the call when people are lost, missing or in distress – often in remote and challenging conditions. Canada's diverse geography and vast wilderness areas require a strong and coordinated search and rescue system, and volunteers play a critical role in helping people when they need it most.

item.title: Minister Champagne to make an announcement on a search and rescue boating safety initiative in the MRC des Chenaux, Quebec
item.description: Members of the media are invited to join the Honourable François-Philippe Champagne, Minister of Finance and National Revenue, on behalf of the Honourable Eleanor Olszewski, Minister of Emergency Management and Community Resilience and Minister responsible for Prairies Economic Development Canada, for an announcement regarding a search and rescue and boating safety initiative in the MRC des Chenaux, Quebec.

item.title: Minister Olszewski to make an announcement supporting volunteer search and rescue across Canada
item.description: Members of the media are invited to join the Honourable Eleanor Olszewski, Minister of Emergency Management and Community Resilience and Minister responsible for Prairies Economic Development Canada, and the Honourable Rebecca Alty, Minister of Crown-Indigenous Relations, for an announcement regarding initiatives that support volunteer search and rescue organizations and help strengthen search and rescue capacity across Canada.
